keys.title: 字段索引

line.description_en:
The full-text index configuration. At least one of the following must exist: full-text index, field index, or scan index.
Full-text index example:
```
{
    "chn": false,
    "caseSensitive": false,
    "token":[","," ","'","\"",";","=","(",")","[","]","{","}","?","@","<","&","/",":","\n","\t","\r"]
}
```

auto_key_detect.description_en: Specifies whether to enable the automatic index discovery feature. After this feature is enabled, fields in logs that do not have indexes are automatically discovered and added to auto_text_keys (automatically discovered indexed fields). The automatically discovered indexed fields are of the text type with analytics enabled. Their case sensitivity and token settings inherit the full-text index configuration
auto_key_detect.description_zh: 是否开启索引自动发现功能。开启后会自动发现日志中未添加索引的字段，并添加到 auto_text_keys （自动发现的索引字段）内。自动发现的索引字段都是 text 文本类型，开启了统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置
auto_key_detect.title: 是否开启索引自动发现功能。开启后会自动发现日志中未添加索引的字段，并添加到 auto_text_keys （自动发现的索引字段）内。auto_text_keys 内的字段是 text 文本类型的字段索引，自动开启统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。

auto_text_keys.description_en: The automatically discovered indexed fields. The automatically discovered indexed fields are of the text type with analytics enabled. Their case sensitivity and token settings inherit the full-text index configuration. After automatic index discovery is disabled, the previously discovered indexes are retained unless you explicitly clear this field
auto_text_keys.description_zh: 自动发现的索引字段。自动发现的索引字段都是 text 文本类型，开启了统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。关闭自动发现索引后，原自动发现的索引将继续保留，除非显式清空此字段

items.description_en: The automatically discovered indexed fields. The automatically discovered indexed fields are of the text type with analytics enabled. Their case sensitivity and token settings inherit the full-text index configuration
items.description_zh: 自动发现的索引字段。自动发现的索引字段都是 text 文本类型，开启了统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置
items.title: 自动发现的索引字段。其字段均为 text 文本类型的字段索引，自动开启统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。

auto_text_keys.title: 自动发现的索引字段。其字段均为 text 文本类型的字段索引，自动开启统计分析能力，且其大小写敏感与分词配置继承全文索引的配置。关闭自动发现索引后，原自动发现的索引将继续保留，除非显式清空此字段

log_reduce.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable LogReduce. After LogReduce is enabled, at most one of the whitelist and blacklist takes effect.

true: LogReduce is enabled.
false (default): LogReduce is not enabled
log_reduce.description_zh:
是否开启日志聚类。开启后白名单与黑名单至多生效其中一个。

true：开启日志聚类。
false（默认值）：不开启日志聚类
log_reduce.title: 是否开启日志聚类

log_reduce_black_list.description_en: The blacklist for filtering clustering fields in LogReduce. This parameter takes effect only when LogReduce is enabled

log_reduce_black_list.title: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤黑名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效

log_reduce_white_list.description_en: The whitelist for filtering clustering fields in LogReduce. This parameter takes effect only when LogReduce is enabled
log_reduce_white_list.description_zh: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤白名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效
log_reduce_white_list.title: 日志聚类的聚类字段过滤白名单，仅当日志聚类开启时有效

max_text_len.description_en: Simple Log Service sets the maximum length of a field value to 2,048 bytes (2 KB) by default. To change the maximum length of a field value, set the maximum length of a statistics field (text). Valid values: 64 to 16384. Unit: bytes
max_text_len.description_zh: 日志服务默认字段值的最大长度为2048字节，即2 KB。如果您需要修改字段值的最大长度，可设置统计字段（text）最大长度，取值范围为64~16384字节
max_text_len.title: 统计字段最大长度
